title: St Paul's ~$36 vs the Temple of Heaven ~$4 in Winter | China Travel Expert
description:
Two of the world's great domed landmarks, one wild price gap. St Paul's Cathedral in London charges £27 for an adult sightseeing ticket — about $36 at today's rate. The Temple of Heaven in Beijing drops to its off-season combo ticket of ¥28 from November 1 — about $4. Same winter week, and Beijing's imperial altar of Heaven costs more than eight times less to walk into.

The Temple of Heaven was completed in 1420 under the Ming emperor Yongle — the same emperor who built the Forbidden City — and Ming and Qing emperors came here to pray to Heaven for a good harvest. It was inscribed by UNESCO in 1998.

🧭 Expert Tip: buy the combo (through) ticket, not the ¥15 park-only ticket — only the combo opens the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, the Echo Wall and the Circular Mound Altar.

伦敦圣保罗大教堂门票 £27，约 $36；北京天坛 11 月起淡季联票 ¥28，约 $4——同一个冬天，差八倍多。
